# Instructables
> A community platform for sharing step-by-step DIY projects, tutorials, and maker ideas across crafts, technology, food, home, and education.

Instructables helps makers explore projects, publish their own how-tos, join contests, and find classroom-friendly resources. Content is organized by major making categories and includes beginner onboarding, community help, and educational materials for teachers.

## Core Categories
- [Circuits](https://www.instructables.com/circuits/): Electronics, Arduino, microcontrollers, robotics, and hardware projects.
- [Workshop](https://www.instructables.com/workshop/): Woodworking, metalworking, tools, fabrication, and shop techniques.
- [Design](https://www.instructables.com/design/): 3D printing, CAD, digital fabrication, and product design projects.
- [Craft](https://www.instructables.com/craft/): Sewing, paper crafts, jewelry, art, and handmade creative projects.
- [Cooking](https://www.instructables.com/cooking/): Recipes, kitchen techniques, baking, drinks, and food projects.
- [Living](https://www.instructables.com/living/): Home improvement, organization, decor, and everyday life hacks.
- [Outside](https://www.instructables.com/outside/): Gardening, camping, bikes, outdoor builds, and nature-related projects.
- [Teachers](https://www.instructables.com/teachers/): Classroom resources, lesson ideas, and educator-focused maker content.

## Publishing and Participation
- [Why Publish?](https://www.instructables.com/create/): Overview of why and how to share projects on Instructables.
- [Get Started](https://www.instructables.com/Get-Started/): Introductory guide for new users learning the platform.
- [Help](https://www.instructables.com/help/): Support resources for accounts, publishing, and site usage.
- [Sitemap](https://www.instructables.com/sitemap/): Directory of major site areas and navigational links.

## Community and Company
- [About](https://www.instructables.com/about/): Background on Instructables, its mission, and company information.
- [Teachers](https://www.instructables.com/teachers/): Education hub for maker learning in schools and classrooms.
- [Create](https://www.instructables.com/create/): Creator-focused landing page for publishing and community participation.

## Learning and Discovery
- [Circuits](https://www.instructables.com/circuits/): Browse electronics tutorials and discover popular hardware builds.
- [Workshop](https://www.instructables.com/workshop/): Explore practical making techniques and shop-based projects.
- [Design](https://www.instructables.com/design/): Find digital design workflows and fabrication-oriented guides.
- [Craft](https://www.instructables.com/craft/): Discover decorative, wearable, and artistic handmade projects.
- [Cooking](https://www.instructables.com/cooking/): Learn recipes and food-making methods from the community.
- [Living](https://www.instructables.com/living/): Browse home, lifestyle, and practical improvement tutorials.
- [Outside](https://www.instructables.com/outside/): Explore outdoor projects, gear ideas, and garden builds.

## Support and Policies

- [Privacy Statement](https://www.autodesk.com/company/legal-notices-trademarks/privacy-statement): Autodesk privacy policy applicable to Instructables users.
- [Legal Notices & Trademarks](https://www.autodesk.com/company/legal-notices-trademarks): Legal notices, trademark information, and related policies.

- [Homepage](https://www.instructables.com/): Main entry point for discovering projects and community content.
